content: Cenomi Mall has a dedicated Entertainment zone on the Third floor featuring VOX Cinemas with IMAX and 4DX screens, a bowling alley, and a family fun center.
The Food Court on the Second floor offers over 30 dining options ranging from quick-service to full-service restaurants, with a family seating area and prayer room access nearby.
Cenomi Mall provides complimentary wheelchair access, family rooms with baby changing facilities on every floor, and a lost-and-found service at the Ground floor Information Desk.
During Ramadan, mall hours shift to 13:00-02:00. Most dining outlets open after Iftar. Special Ramadan promotions are available at participating stores.
